description: List the alternatives registered under a decision point — the Artifact pointers GOVERNED_BY the Decision, each with its export location, ready to feed to analyze_alternatives. An empty list says why: no alternatives registered, a decision that is not `proposed`, or an id that names no Decision. Ask for this when you want to see the roads recorded under an open choice before comparing them. Ask for this to see which candidate designs we did register against a decision.

decision_id.description: The Decision whose registered alternatives to list — a `proposed` decision point that `register_alternative` has been called on.

name: alternatives_for
title: Alternatives for a Decision
